metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully navigated to slide 5 and changed all textbox font colors to yellow (FFFF00) using Format > Character > Font Effects dialog.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate to specific slides, select all text in a textbox, use Format > Character dialog to set exact font colors via hex code.
metadata.task_rationale: Multi-slide compositional task with different target colors per slide. Slide 5 gets yellow (same as original), slide 3 gets red. Tests the agent's ability to apply distinct color operations to different slides in sequence.
metadata.explanation: Evaluator reads slides 3 and 5, checks slide 5 runs are FFFF00 (yellow) and slide 3 runs are FF0000 (red). Partial credit: 0.5 per slide. Initial state fails all checks (slide 5 is green/white, slide 3 is green/dark blue). [Fixed: renamed getter/metric functions from invalid 8-char suffix '22d6ff54' to proper 32-char MD5 hash '0fbb4b3515e1009c69bc08919cd2b491' computed from '57667013-ea97-417c-9dce-2713091e6e2a|4']

scoring_breakdown.slide5_all_yellow: 0.5 - All text runs in slide 5 have font color #FFFF00
scoring_breakdown.slide3_all_red: 0.5 - All text runs in slide 3 have font color #FF0000

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly targets slides at 0-based indices 2 (slide 3) and 4 (slide 5), matching the instruction's slide 3 and slide 5 requirements.
Getter iterates all shapes with text frames, collecting explicit RGB colors from every text run — covers 'all textboxes' as required.
Metric checks slide5 colors against FFFF00 (yellow) and slide3 colors against FF0000 (red), matching the instruction exactly.
Partial credit of 0.5 per slide correctly reflects the two independent sub-goals.
None handling: runs without explicit color type return None, causing that slide to fail — semantically correct since a correctly-completed task should have explicit colors set.
Expected values in evaluator rules (FFFF00, FF0000) match the instruction's yellow and red requirements.
Empty colors list is handled with 'continue', preventing vacuous-truth false positives on slides with no text runs.
Negative control resistance: initial state (green/white on slide 5, green/dark blue on slide 3) will correctly fail both checks.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider also checking paragraph-level font colors (para.font.color) as a fallback when run-level color is None, since LibreOffice may store some colors at the paragraph level rather than the run level.
If the colors list is empty for a slide, consider returning 0 for that slide explicitly rather than silently skipping, to make failures more debuggable.
